      "observations": [
        "All23 owned C++/IDL/JS/Rust/build/lock/vendor diffs read, including imported CopyFolder request/response tests and feature-gated interop conversions. Same-server folder copies now use server CopyFolders, while moves use MoveFolders/local reparenting and cross-server copies retain FolderCopyHandler. Operation callback requires exactly one folder ID. Copy updates the whole folder hierarchy because its sync token is server-level, and explicitly leaves copied messages to later selection/expansion. Copy completion is not a downloaded-message barrier.",
        "Owned CompleteCopyMoveFolderOperation finds the named destination child, assigns its EWS ID and notifies the copy service. Missing child assigns rv before returning so the listener guard sees failure. SetStringProperty return and direct NotifyMessageCopyServiceComplete return are not assigned to watched rv; the guard is not proof every helper error is forwarded. Same-server dispatch in the owned method ignores immediate MoveFolders/CopyFolders return; accepted dispatch assigns/checks rv. Keep this later difference separate and reuse existing watched-status lesson.",
        "All7 changed vendored file bytes match their owned checksum entries. Cargo/source/lock dependency rev changes14c291a9 to212005209355ce323958ba3d7b1cdd31861da5b3 and ews_xpcom enables interop. The feature gates From conversions in the owning crate, replacing local copy/move-item wrappers; folder request types flatten shared CopyMoveFolderData and serialize the operation-specific root. Folder CopyMoveOperation returns false because hierarchy sync is explicitly handled by its folder consumer, not the message-item resync path. This is not evidence no resync is needed.",
        "Changed JS tests create two parents/one child with prefixed names, move/copy the child, and directly assert source absence/presence plus destination existence. All new JS assertions have nonempty should messages. Actual helper calls destinationFolder.copyFolder directly and returns PromiseCopyListener, so these tests do not independently exercise copy-service queue scheduling. They do not assert recursive subfolders, copied items, returned EWS ID, server bytes or message-download completion.",
        "The new fake CopyFolder copies only direct source items into a _copy folder and does not recursively copy subfolders in its implemented loop. It passes original folderIds to generic response builder, which echoes each ID verbatim, even though fake-created IDs use _copy. Existence-only assertions therefore do not prove correct copied-ID mapping. Copied SyntheticMessage is rebuilt from headers/bodyPart/metaState references; no independent deep-copy guarantee follows.",
        "Imported Rust tests directly verify exact serialized CopyFolder XML and deserialized folder response structure. The actual shared assert_serialized_content/assert_deserialized_content helpers use assert_eq! without custom messages; record that missing-message limitation rather than inventing caller messages. No Rust/JS test, vendor/build, server folder operation, FFI or runtime ran. External1980963 and protocol-reference URLs are bounded locators, not additional body evidence.",
        "Read complete primary Bug1977653 bodies0–2 and full D259121 timeline, all25 actual inlines including absolute old-diff1099086 inline1423789, no summary edits. Original hesitation and coarse biff/test workaround are explicitly obsolete after rebase on D258237; do not retain their timing workaround as final test behavior. The newer callback chain waits for folder hierarchy, deliberately leaves copied-message sync to later selection, and reviewer accepts that documented tradeoff. Future std::promise/std::future and generic nsIMsgIncomingServer placement are proposals, not implementation.",
        "Reviewer requests changes for cleanup/documentation, then re-review/acceptance follows source updates. Owned source verifies returned-folder tuple documentation, .name-based assertions, XPIDL NS_IMETHODIMP, mock direct-item copying and Rust false-return rationale. A Done label does not establish every obsolete class/interface cleanup: EwsFolder.h is not an owned changed path, and I do not credit that header cleanup without distinct source proof. Later rogue-interface reintroduction/merge mistake is reported and fixed by author, but no extra interface behavior is inferred beyond the inspected final owned diff.",
        "Granular hierarchy follow-up1980963, external ews-rs PR58 and source-reference links remain bounded locators. Author good-Try and completed-build timeline events are historical reports, not fresh tests. Later rebases after conflicts precede the recorded landing. Existing source analysis retains mock response-ID mismatch and existence-only test limits; approval does not expand those assertions or prove remote copies/downloads."
      ],
